notes.title: 🚨 Big Update is here - Police Station! 🚨
notes.content:
[p]The update has arrived! A completely new location has been added to the game - [b]Police Station[/b].
[/p][p]What’s new:

🏢 12 rooms to monitor
👀 215 new anomalies
🔑 10 secret endings
[/p][p]An atmosphere that will make you watch the cameras even more carefully…
[/p][p]This is the biggest [b]Silent Anomalies[/b] update yet, and we can’t wait to hear your impressions 🙌
Share your thoughts in the comments and tell us how many secrets you’ve managed to uncover![/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update — We Need Your Help!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!
Work on the new location is in its final stages, and we’d love to get your feedback 🙌[/p][p]We’re testing some new anomalies and want to know: do you find them fun and fair, or maybe a bit too difficult to notice? Should we keep them in the game or remove them?[/p][p]Here are two examples:[/p][p]-A mug being turned the wrong way.[/p][p]-A folder disappearing from a shelf.[/p][p][/p][p]We’d really appreciate your thoughts in the comments below 👇
Your feedback is incredibly important to help us make the game even better![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311138/13a6af55ad665fe93ebe03782b62f30ae6dca524.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311138/49b7bae9018dbc3a7c25b0b2feafda16008bb688.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311138/2a10a3a2dd7e8c3523068562902753e2964c6d0f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311138/8db5f59d847153042a42744cb92bfdde5712da80.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🗺️ New map — progress update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to share a quick update — work on the new location is going well!
I won’t spoil too much yet, but it’s going to be quite different from the house you’ve seen so far… expect new types of anomalies, interactions, and a whole new mood 👁️

Thank you all for your patience and support — I’m doing my best to make this next update worth the wait.

notes.title: Update [Version 1.0.7] — Improvements and Fixes!
notes.content:
💡 Fixed lighting in some scenes
🎞️ Added new animations
🌕 Added brightness settings
⚙️ Added graphics quality settings (for low-end PCs)

Thanks to everyone who leaves feedback — you help make the game better 💙

notes.title: It has begun!
notes.content:
We’re already working on a new location! More weirdness, more tension — and of course, even more anomalies 😈
Details will be revealed gradually. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes (v1.0.6)
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the camera could get stuck after deactivating it
Corrected material issues on some objects

Thanks for playing and reporting bugs — it helps a lot! 💙

notes.title: 🏆 Achievements are now available!
notes.content:
You can now earn rewards for your progress and attention to detail!
We've added achievements for completing floors, spotting anomalies, and unlocking secret endings.

🕹 Bonus: Achievements are retroactive — if you've already completed certain content, they will unlock automatically after the update.

Thank you for your support — enjoy the game! 💙

notes.title: 🛠️ Update [Version 1.0.3] — Improvements & Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello, Watchers! 🔍👁️

We have released a new update that makes the game even better! Thank you all for your feedback and support. Here’s what has changed:

✨ Improvements:
✅ Increased hitboxes for disappearing objects.
✅ Added a "Game Info" panel — now you’ll have more details about the project.
✅ Added a "Secret Endings" info panel — for those who want to discover all the secrets!

🔧 Fixes:
✅  Fixed a bug with the kitchen door.
✅  Fixed animations.
✅  Pause fix — the game now pauses correctly.
✅  Japanese localization: fixed text spacing for better readability.

🚀 Thank you for playing! If you find anything interesting or have suggestions — let us know in the community! 💙

notes.title: 🛠 We have improved the game!
notes.content: Animations on the 2nd floor now work even better. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 🕵️‍♂️ The game is OUT! Can you spot them?.. 🔥
notes.content:
The day has finally come! [b]Silent Anomalies[/b] is now available on [b]Steam[/b]! Ready to challenge your eyes and mind?
👀 Watch carefully…
😨 Track the changes…
❓ But are you sure you notice everything?..

Thank you to everyone who supported us during development, played the demo, left feedback, and added the game to their wishlist.
It’s been a long journey, and we’re thrilled to finally share the game with you! ❤️

🛠️ If you spot any bugs or have suggestions, feel free to share them in the community!

Now… turn on the cameras, and let the game begin! 📹

notes.title: New demo update: more fear and anomalies! 🔥
notes.content:
🎉 [b]We’ve listened to your feedback![/b] 🎉

The demo is now even more exciting and scarier! 😱

We’ve added 5 new anomalies that will surely leave an impression. Among them:
👹 Creepy monsters lurking in the shadows.
💀 Jump scares that will test your nerves.

Are you ready to face new challenges and uncover all the secrets of the house? 🕵️‍♂️

Don’t wait — update the demo now and test your skills! 🔥

🖤 Thank you for playing, and we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: We are getting closer!
notes.content:
Want more content, interesting videos, and behind-the-scenes details about our game? We have launched official pages on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube!
There you will find exclusive materials, riddles, anomalies, and the opportunity to communicate with us.

Your feedback and support are very important to us!
